% imakeidx's main index and two named indexes, one named for the job and
% one not, each with its .ind beside the document from an earlier build
% that loaded hyperref, and a named index without entries yet, whose
% makeindex run writes an empty .ind
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{imakeidx}
\makeindex
\makeindex[name=test-staleaux-ind-named-authors,title=Index of authors]
\makeindex[name=test-staleaux-people,title=Index of people]
\makeindex[name=test-staleaux-editors,title=Index of editors]
\begin{document}
An apple\index{Apple}, named by Knuth\index[test-staleaux-ind-named-authors]{Knuth}, after Euler\index[test-staleaux-people]{Euler}.
\printindex
\printindex[test-staleaux-ind-named-authors]
\printindex[test-staleaux-people]
\printindex[test-staleaux-editors]
\end{document}
